title: Travis Hunter: "Little bit" of relief to get first interception

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Travis Hunter: "Little bit" of relief to get first interception
sources.description: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen's talk about giving Travis Hunter more to do in Week 3 didn't result in a major change to his role, but the 2025 first-round pick was able to check off one career milestone.
